name: 外部运输需求计划 (4OZ)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item supports your company´s transportation planning.

The sales order-based transportation requirement (freight unit) is created in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition Public Edition (scope item 6W1). The freight unit is replicated at the same time to the connected external planning system (SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition).

In the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system, the transportation planner creates a freight order and assigns the freight unit. Additionally, the transportation planner assigns a carrier to the freight order as the responsible party to execute the transportation of the goods.

When the transportation planner is done with the planning activities, the freight order is saved and automatically replicated to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition Public Edition for further processing (scope item 6W1).

Key Process Flow

  • Select freight unit
  • Create freight order

Business Benefits

  • Improves the integration between SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private and Public Edition: Supports your company's transportation planning in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and transportation execution and settlement in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition Public Edition.
  • Reduce freight costs through early order-based transportation planning
  • Get fewer delivery changes during logistics execution through late delivery creation close to warehouse activities and goods issue
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目支持公司的运输计划。

在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition（公共版）（范围项目 6W1）中创建基于销售订单的运输需求（货运单位）。同时将货运单位复制到连接的外部计划系统 (SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition)。

在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统中，运输计划员创建货运订单并分配货运单位。此外，运输计划员将运输公司分配到货运订单作为执行货物运输的负责方。

当运输计划员完成计划活动时，货运订单将保存并自动复制到 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition（公共版）以进行进一步处理（范围项目 6W1）。

关键流程流

  • 选择货运单位
  • 创建货运订单

业务优势

  • 改进 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 和 Public Edition 之间的集成：支持 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中的公司运输计划以及 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition Public Edition 中的运输执行和结算。
  • 通过早期基于订单的运输计划降低货运成本
  • 通过接近仓库活动和发货的延迟交货创建，减少物流执行期间的交货更改
